_comment: Florida only for v1. Both granularities are searched deliberately: a statewide query does NOT saturate, because statewide relevance ranking favours large employers with many postings. Measured 2026-08-04: a Tampa-level query surfaced 10 employers absent from the statewide results, Miami surfaced 6. Statewide catches breadth, cities catch the single-location independents.
_cities_note: Top 30 Florida cities by population. Population rank is not the same as independent-practice density — Naples, Sarasota, Ocala and Pensacola fall outside the top 30 but are high-density independent-specialty markets, while Deltona, Palm Coast and Miami Gardens are largely residential. Revisit once yield-per-city data exists (design doc §11.4).

search._comment: hours_old 168 = 7 days. This is the RECENCY WINDOW OF THE SEARCH, not a lead lifetime — v1 keeps leads indefinitely and shows the posting date so an operator can judge staleness (design doc §11.1).
